name: salestrack-pro
description: Gold & Jewelry Sales Performance Tracking System
author: SalesTrack Pro

scripts.dev:win7-32: npm run set:electron:22 && npm install --arch=ia32 && npx electron-builder install-app-deps --arch=ia32 && cross-env APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win7 npm run dev
scripts.dev:win10: npm run set:electron:31 && npm install --arch=x64 && npx electron-builder install-app-deps --arch=x64 && cross-env APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win10 npm run dev
scripts.set:electron:22: npx json -I -f package.json -e "this.electron='22.3.0'" && npx json -I -f package.json -e "this.devDependencies.electron='22.3.0'"
scripts.set:electron:31: npx json -I -f package.json -e "this.electron='^31.0.0'" && npx json -I -f package.json -e "this.devDependencies.electron='^31.0.0'"
scripts.build:win7: npm run set:electron:22 && npm install --arch=x64 && npm run clean && cross-env APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win7 CHANNEL=win7 npm run dist:win
scripts.build:win7-32: npm run set:electron:22 && npm install --arch=ia32 && npm run clean && cross-env APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win7 CHANNEL=win7 npm run dist:win32
scripts.build:win10: npm run set:electron:31 && npm install --arch=x64 && npm run clean && cross-env APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win10 CHANNEL=latest npm run dist:win
scripts.publish:win7-32: cross-env-shell "CHANNEL=win7 APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win7 npm run set:electron:22 && npm install --arch=ia32 && npm run clean && npx electron-builder --win --ia32 --publish always"
scripts.publish:win10: cross-env-shell "CHANNEL=latest APP_ID=com.salestrackpro.app.win10 npm run set:electron:31 && npm install --arch=x64 && npm run clean && npx electron-builder --win --x64 --publish always"
